title: McKesson Reports Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results and Raises Full Year Adjusted EPS Guidance
summary: McKesson reports fiscal 2027 second quarter results and raises full-year adjusted earnings per diluted share guidance.
body_markdown:
**IRVING, Texas, November 4, 2026** - McKesson Corporation (NYSE:MCK) today announced results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Second Quarter Highlights:**


- Consolidated revenues of $111.0 billion increased 8%.
- Earnings per diluted share of $10.44 increased $1.52.
- Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share of $11.68 increased 18%.
- Generated $3.1 billion of cash flow from operations and $2.9 billion of Free Cash Flow.


**Fiscal 2027 Full Year Outlook:**


- Raised Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range to $45.60 to $46.40, from the previous range of $44.20 to $45.00.
- Fiscal 2027 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range indicates 17% to 19% growth compared to the prior year.
- The Company does not forecast GAAP earnings per diluted share1.


“McKesson delivered another quarter of strong results, reflecting operational strength in our core business segments and disciplined execution across the enterprise,” said Brian Tyler, chair and chief executive officer. “We continue to invest strategically to advance healthcare outcomes and create long-term value. We further strengthened our portfolio through transactions that will expand our capabilities and deepen our presence in key growth areas, while maintaining our commitment to financial discipline. We are confident in our ability to leverage differentiated solutions and create value for customers, partners, patients, and shareholders. As we close out a strong first half of our fiscal year, I want to thank Team McKesson for their unwavering commitment to excellence and for the impact they make across healthcare every day.”


**Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Result Summary**


Second quarter revenues were $111.0 billion, an increase of 8% from a year ago, driven by growth in the North American Pharmaceutical and Oncology & Multispecialty segments due to increased prescription volumes and distribution of specialty products, partially offset by lower contributions from branded pharmaceuticals.


Second quarter earnings per diluted share was $10.44 compared to $8.92 a year ago, an increase of $1.52.


Second quarter Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share was $11.68 compared to $9.86 a year ago, an increase of 18%, driven by strong operational growth across the North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology & Multispecialty, and Prescription Technology Solutions segments, and a lower share count.


During the three months ended September 30, 2026, McKesson generated cash from operations of $3.1 billion, and invested $123 million in capital expenditures, resulting in Free Cash Flow of $2.9 billion. During the first six months of the fiscal year, McKesson generated cash from operations of $2.9 billion, and invested $275 million in capital expenditures, resulting in Free Cash Flow of $2.6 billion.


For the first six months of the fiscal year, McKesson returned $3.6 billion of cash to shareholders, which included $3.4 billion of common stock repurchases and $198 million of dividend payments.


**Business Highlights**


- McKesson signed an agreement to extend its pharmaceutical distribution partnership with CVS Health through June 2032.
- On October 5, 2026, McKesson signed a definitive agreement to invest approximately $1.4 billion for a minority interest of approximately 49% in Option Care Health, Inc. This transaction aligns with McKesson’s strategy in supporting the delivery of complex specialty therapies and expanding patient access through community-based care. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including approval by Option Care Health’s stockholders and the receipt of required regulatory approvals.
- On November 2, 2026, McKesson completed the acquisition of Precision Medicine Group, LLC, a global provider of clinical research and biopharma commercialization service. This acquisition represents a meaningful milestone in advancing its strategy in oncology, multispecialty, and biopharma services.
- On November 2, 2026, PRISM Vision Group expanded its network with the addition of Spectrum Vision Partners, adding more than 150 providers and bringing its total provider network to more than 350.


**North American Pharmaceutical Segment**


- Revenues were $91.4 billion, an increase of 6%, driven by increased prescription transaction volumes, including higher volumes from specialty products to health systems and strategic accounts, partially offset by lower contributions from branded pharmaceuticals.
- Segment Operating Profit was $1.1 billion. Adjusted Segment Operating Profit was $1.0 billion, an increase of 22%, driven by growth in the distribution of specialty products to health systems and strategic accounts.


**Oncology & Multispecialty Segment**


- Revenues were $15.0 billion, an increase of 24%, driven by growth in provider solutions and specialty distribution.
- Segment Operating Profit was $352 million. Adjusted Segment Operating Profit was $427 million, an increase of 8%, driven by growth in provider solutions and specialty distribution.


**Prescription Technology Solutions Segment**


- Revenues were $1.5 billion, an increase of 10%, driven by increased prescription volumes in third-party logistics and access solutions, partially offset by lower contributions from hub dispensing services.
- Segment Operating Profit was $275 million. Adjusted Segment Operating Profit was $307 million, an increase of 18%, driven by higher demand for access solutions.


**Medical-Surgical Solutions Segment**


- Revenues were $3.1 billion, an increase of 5%, driven by growth across the extended and ambulatory care channels.
- Segment Operating Profit was $164 million. Adjusted Segment Operating Profit was $225 million, a decrease of 10%, driven by lower contributions from the ambulatory care channel due to product mix, partially offset by growth in the extended care channel.


**Fiscal 2027 Outlook**


McKesson does not provide forward-looking guidance on a GAAP basis as the company is unable to provide a quantitative reconciliation of forward-looking Non-GAAP measures to the most directly comparable forward-looking GAAP measure, without unreasonable effort. McKesson cannot reasonably forecast LIFO inventory-related adjustments, certain litigation loss and gain contingencies, transaction related expenses and adjustments, restructuring, impairment and related charges, and other adjustments, which are difficult to predict and estimate. These items are generally uncertain and depend on various factors, many of which are beyond the company's control, and as such, any associated estimate and its impact on GAAP performance could vary materially.


McKesson is raising its fiscal 2027 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance to $45.60 to $46.40 from the previous range of $44.20 to $45.00.“The raise in fiscal 2027 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance is underpinned by the strength in our business and the confidence we have in our ability to execute consistently,” said Kenny Cheung, executive vice president and chief financial officer. “We are committed to building towards the future through disciplined capital deployment and strategic investments.”


Additional modeling considerations will be provided in the earnings call presentation.

GAAP refers to the U.S. generally accepted accounting principles. This press release includes GAAP financial measures as well as Non-GAAP financial measures, including Adjusted Gross Profit, Adjusted Operating Expenses, Adjusted Other Income, Adjusted Interest Expense, Adjusted Income Tax Expense, Adjusted Earnings, Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share, Adjusted Segment Operating Profit, Adjusted Segment Operating Profit Margin, Adjusted Corporate Expenses, Adjusted Operating Profit, and Free Cash Flow which are financial measures not calculated in accordance with GAAP.
